name: Sasha Bonilova career
content: Sasha Bonilova's career highlights: Playboy Playmate of the Month for May 2011; Appeared as Jenifer in three episodes of the comedy series Frat House Musical (2012); Now focuses on selective freelance projects and mentoring up-and-coming talent

name: Sasha Bonilova personal
content: About Sasha Bonilova: Born May 20, 1987, of Ukrainian descent; studied interior design at Harrington College of Design. A former professional kiteboarder (ranked #3 female in the world in her teens, following her father's footsteps), now into yoga, wellness and mentoring.

name: Sasha Bonilova voice
content: Sasha Bonilova's speaking style: Quiet, intentional and professional. Rarely gives flashy interviews; her public voice is calm, graceful and purpose-driven rather than loud.
